column1: # Chinese disease names -> ICPC-3 D component. OUR writing, Apache-2.0.
# NOT a translation of ICPC-3. Same rule as symptoms_zh.tsv: the left-hand side
# is what a person writes when naming a condition they have been diagnosed
# with, the right-hand side is our judgement about which code that is, and no
# ICPC-3 term appears in this file in any language. See res/icpc3/icpc3.NOTICE.
# This is the D axis, not the S axis. 过敏 is refused there, because as a
# complaint it names a mechanism rather than a symptom, and codes here as the
# allergy diagnosis; both are right, because the caller says which question it
# is asking. Nothing here belongs in symptoms_zh.tsv and nothing there belongs
# Two sentinels instead of a code:
#   !too-broad   names a family, not a diagnosis. Never answered.
#   !ambiguous   the classification asks which one. A person can say; we cannot.
传染性单核细胞增多症

column3: on the D axis this is the allergy diagnosis; the S axis refuses it as a mechanism
iron deficiency (BD66), B12 or folate (BD67), haemolytic (BD65) and other (BD77) are four codes
the site picks the code: radius/ulna LD35, tibia/fibula LD36, hand/foot LD37, femur LD38
osteoarthrosis (LD78/LD79/LD80) and rheumatoid arthritis (LD74) are different diagnoses
the fungal skin infection; 脚气病 (beriberi) is a vitamin deficiency and is not this
